summary: Full e2e test of the new backup SOURCE TAG feature ('VM' = Hornetsecurity VM/Altaro, '365' = Hornetsecurity 365/legacy) on all three surfaces + the /login mobile banner. BACKEND: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_backup_source_tag_iter135.py - 9/9 PASS. GET /api/overview/clients returns backup.source='365' for the only client with backups (86BIT_Office, da3d6e40-..., total=1 error=1); GET /api/tv/dashboard returns clients[].backup with source='365' (note: payload key is `clients`, NOT `client_summaries`); GET /api/mobile/dashboard with X-Mobile-Token returns byte-identical source map to /tv and correctly rejects requests without the token (403). Cross-surface parity overview<->tv<->mobile verified. Because live data has 0 VM backup items, the 'vm' branch is not reachable via the API, so I unit-tested build_backup_by_client() with fakes: VM priority path yields source='vm' with correct totals, and the 365-only path yields source='365'; 'source' is correctly omitted when total==0. FRONTEND (Playwright, preview URL, admin login + computed TOTP): (1) Desktop / dashboard -> data-testid='svc-tag-365' renders next to the BACKUP line, text '365', blue rgb(56,189,248) on rgba(56,189,248,0.15); svc-tag-vm absent as expected. (2) /tv -> data-testid='tv-backup-tag-365' renders in the BACKUP section header, text '365', rgb(125,211,252), 9px; no 'tv-backup-tag-undefined' leakage. (3) /m#t=<pairing token> -> list loads, clicking mobile-client-row opens the detail sheet and data-testid='mm-backup-tag-365' renders, text '365', 8px. (4) /login with desktop UA: login-mobile-banner absent (count=0); with a spoofed iPhone UA the banner renders, text 'Sei su smartphone? Apri la versione mobile ottimizzata', href='/m', and clicking it navigates to /m. No JS errors on any surface (only the pre-existing pre-2FA 403 and the /ws/alerts WebSocket warning). Feature works as specified; issues found are cosmetic/semantic, listed below.

minor.issue: Only 1 client in preview DB and VM backup total is 0, so backup.source can only ever be '365' with current data - the 'vm' branch is untestable end-to-end via API (covered by unit test instead). Seed at least one client with a matching hornetsecurity_vm_customers mapping to demo/validate the violet VM tag.
Client array key is `clients` while the code/comments call them `client_summaries` - misleading naming for API consumers/tests (no functional impact).

ui_bugs.issue: The unit label after the counter is hard-coded 'VM' ('/ {total} VM', '✓ {ok}/{total} VM ok'), so with the new tag the UI now reads contradictorily: 'BACKUP [365]  1 falliti / 1 VM'. When backup.source==='365' the items are 365 workloads/tenants, not VMs. Make the label depend on source (e.g. 'VM' vs 'job'/'workload').

issues: The svc-tag font-size is 7px (measured height 9.8px) - below practical legibility at 1920x1080; suggest >=9-10px.
Tag color rgb(56,189,248) on rgba(56,189,248,0.15) over the dark card is fine for contrast, but at 7px the antialiasing makes '365' look like a smudge.
With a single client the wallboard leaves ~80% of the 1920x1080 screen empty (pre-existing layout/data issue, unrelated to this feature).
mm-backup-tag font-size is 8px; consider 9-10px for a phone screen.

action_items: Make the '/ N VM' and '✓ N/N VM ok' unit labels source-aware on TV and Mobile (currently says 'VM' while the tag says '365').
Bump the tag font-size on the desktop card (7px -> ~9-10px) and mobile (8px -> ~9-10px).

Optional: seed one client with a real hornetsecurity_vm_customers mapping so the violet 'VM' tag path is demonstrable end-to-end (86BIT_Office is currently mapped to the unrelated VM customer 'loghilton.com', already reported in iteration_134).
critical_code_review_comments: TvDashboardPage.js:329 builds the testid as `tv-backup-tag-${i.bk.source}` - it is guarded by `i.bk?.source &&` so no 'undefined' leaks today, but if the backend ever returns an unexpected source the testid/colors silently degrade. Prefer normalising: const src = i.bk.source === 'vm' ? 'vm' : '365'.

The source-tag rendering logic (color map + label) is now duplicated verbatim in three files (DashboardPage SvcLine, TvDashboardPage, MobileMonitorPage). Extract a tiny <BackupSourceTag source={...}/> component to keep colors/labels in one place.

backup_aggregation.build_backup_by_client sets 'source' only when total>0, while routes/overview.py re-derives it independently (duplicated priority logic). overview.py should just consume the aggregation helper to avoid drift.

Data inconsistency worth checking: the mobile detail alert list shows 'Backup VM fallito: SRVDATI' for a client whose card is tagged '365' - the alert engine and the card aggregation classify the same failure differently (vmbackup_jobs alert exists but VM mapping total is 0).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks pass (desktop tag, TV tag, mobile tag, login banner mobile-only + link to /m)

The only failure during testing was in my own first test version, which looked up `client_summaries` in the /tv payload while the endpoint actually returns `clients`; fixed in the test file. The remaining findings are cosmetic (7-8px tag font) and semantic (hard-coded 'VM' unit label next to a '365' tag).
